description: Three oscillators, each fading through four waves into its own wavefolder, with three separate outputs and a master mix

params.text: Fades that oscillator between its sine and triangle blend and its sawtooth and square blend
Sets that oscillator's octave, from four to twelve
Shifts that oscillator by whole semitones, seven down to seven up
Tunes that oscillator by up to a semitone either way
Attenuates and inverts the linear FM input, which is added to that oscillator's frequency in hertz
Attenuates and inverts the exponential FM input for that oscillator
Sets how many times that oscillator's wave is folded back on itself, from barely folded to ten times over
Attenuates and inverts the fold CV for that oscillator, which follows the size of the voltage whichever way it swings
Offsets that oscillator's wave before it is folded, -5V to 5V, so that the folding falls unevenly on the two halves
Attenuates and inverts the symmetry CV for that oscillator
Sets the level of that oscillator at its own output and in the master mix
Fades that oscillator between a sine and a triangle
Fades that oscillator between a sawtooth and a square
Attenuates the level CV of that oscillator
Sets the level of the master output, unity at its default and twice unity fully clockwise
In one position the second oscillator takes the first oscillator's pitch input; in the other it uses its own jack
In one position the third oscillator takes the second oscillator's pitch input; in the other it uses its own jack

inputs.text: Sets that oscillator's pitch, a volt to the octave, added to its tuning knobs
Modulates that oscillator's frequency directly rather than by the octave, attenuated by the LIN knob
Modulates that oscillator's pitch by the octave, attenuated by the EXP knob
Folds that oscillator further, attenuated by the fold attenuverter
Offsets that oscillator's wave before folding, attenuated by the symmetry attenuverter
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the wave fade of that oscillator is set by its sliders alone
Adds to that oscillator's level, 10V adding the whole of what its level attenuator allows

outputs.text: That oscillator on its own, after folding and its level

notes: the three oscillator level knobs start at zero, so a new module is silent even though the master level starts at unity

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
